supersedes.classification: admission design infeasible; no model evaluation executed under it

task: controlled recovery of a masked source identifier: the query record's identifiers are absent from the bundle; correct = the candidate carrying the same original DOI, or abstention when no other record carries it. Not natural missing-identifier resolution; not human-adjudicated identity.
unit: lineage group (connected component of records sharing an original or notice DOI or PMID, or a Record ID); one query per group, the smallest ordinal with a valid original DOI; one decision per group; candidates never include the query record
index: data/index/bench/build1/rw-2f116e9ffed718e6.sqlite (pinned snapshot; same digest set as the five benchmark builds)

label_rule.positive: another accepted record carries the query's original DOI; target doi:<key>
label_rule.negative: no other record carries it; the correct answer is abstention

excluded_unresolved.conflicting_original_pmid: a target record carries a different original PMID than the query
excluded_unresolved.doi_shared_by_distinct_titles: a target record's title-token Jaccard with the query is below 0.5 (a DOI shared by distinct works, such as a supplement DOI); metadata is used only to exclude, never to include
excluded_unresolved.pmid_shared_with_different_doi: negative whose original PMID is carried by a record with another original DOI

strata.rule: from retrieval features of the deterministic candidate list only, never from a baseline or model decision
strata.positive/disagreement: no target record agrees with the query on year, author score >= 0.5 and title cosine >= 0.9 (any target record counts; this repairs v1, which used the lowest-ordinal target)
strata.positive/competitor: some target record agrees, and a non-target candidate has title cosine >= 0.6
strata.positive/other: some target record agrees and no non-target candidate has title cosine >= 0.6
strata.negative/other: top candidate title cosine < 0.6, or no candidate

splits.prior_use_excluded_from_holdout: the 160 v1 groups and every group with an event id or DOI named in docs/verification/stage-02 before v2
splits.development: the v1 groups (relabeled) plus fresh groups whose sha256('20261028:<min ordinal>') mod 10 < 3
splits.separation: checked programmatically at the draw: no event id or identifier key of a holdout group occurs in any development or prior group

holdout_quota_rationale: Sample-size change preregistered for feasibility (dev-audit.json): the fresh pool holds no disagreement positives (all 12 are v1 groups), and baseline errors occur almost only on near-duplicate negatives (28.4%, Wilson 95% 22.9-34.7%) and similar-title negatives (2.2%). 300 groups (150/150) give about 29 expected baseline errors. Strata are oversampled by a retrieval-feature rule, never by baseline outcome; results are reported per stratum.

attainability_rule.if_not_attainable: stop before any holdout prediction and report the limitation; no redraw, no quota change

screening.cases: the same 40 development cases for both candidates, drawn from dev-set.json by seed 20261029 with 6 per stratum where available
screening.rule: pick the candidate with more correct decisions under a wrapper calibrated on the remaining development cases; ties: lower warm p95 latency; a candidate that breaks a resource limit is rejected

calibration.wrapper: select the top candidate iff score >= tau_s and score - second >= tau_m
calibration.grid: tau_s over the development score quantiles in steps of 0.25 logit, tau_m in {0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3}
calibration.objective: most correct development decisions subject to development negative false selections <= the baseline's; ties: larger tau_s, then larger tau_m

metrics.all_case_accuracy: correct decisions / all holdout groups (positive: selects the target; negative: abstains)
metrics.positive_recall: positives whose target is selected / positives
metrics.candidate_recall_at_5: positives whose target is among the candidates / positives
metrics.abstention: abstentions / groups, overall and for positives and negatives
metrics.critical_confusions: selections whose anchor equals the query's notice key
metrics.prohibited_fact_writes: index digest after the run differs from before

analysis.unit: lineage group; each case scored with independent forward passes and no shared context
analysis.primary_test: exact one-sided McNemar binomial test on discordant groups (b = baseline right and AI wrong, c = baseline wrong and AI right)
analysis.effect_sizes: relative error reduction (errors_baseline - errors_AI) / errors_baseline and accuracy difference, each with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval over groups (10,000 resamples, seed 20261030)
analysis.strata: every metric also per stratum, descriptive

admission.resources: within the CPU envelope; complete prediction and usage records

no_holdout_revision: One frozen model pipeline, run once on the holdout. No prompt, threshold, encoding or artifact change after any holdout prediction; no retries; failures count as abstentions.
frozen_model: recorded in protocol-v2-frozen.json before the holdout draw
